title: SQLite store: tables, indexes, FTS5, query plans, integrity

cases.title: core tables exist
cases.sqlite: SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' ORDER BY name

cases.title: the nine user indexes exist
cases.sqlite: SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='index' AND name LIKE 'idx_%' ORDER BY name

cases.title: index column lists match the store's DDL
cases.sqlite: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='index' AND name IN ('idx_nodes_label','idx_nodes_name','idx_nodes_file','idx_edges_target_type') ORDER BY name

cases.title: nodes_fts is an FTS5 external-content table with the body column
cases.sqlite: SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE name='nodes_fts'

cases.title: nodes_fts holds one row per node
cases.sqlite: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM nodes) AS nodes, (SELECT count(*) FROM nodes_fts) AS fts

cases.title: fts row count equals node count
cases.sqlite: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM nodes) = (SELECT count(*) FROM nodes_fts)

cases.title: label lookups use idx_nodes_label
cases.sqlite: EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN SELECT id FROM nodes WHERE project='{{project}}' AND label='Function'

cases.title: name lookups use idx_nodes_name
cases.sqlite: EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN SELECT id FROM nodes WHERE project='{{project}}' AND name='hub'

cases.title: file lookups use idx_nodes_file
cases.sqlite: EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN SELECT id FROM nodes WHERE project='{{project}}' AND file_path='app/money.py'

cases.title: outbound edge walks use an edges source index
cases.sqlite: EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN SELECT target_id FROM edges WHERE source_id=1 AND type='CALLS'

cases.title: inbound edge walks use an edges target index
cases.sqlite: EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN SELECT source_id FROM edges WHERE target_id=1 AND type='CALLS'

cases.title: edge-type counts use idx_edges_type
cases.sqlite: EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN SELECT count(*) FROM edges WHERE project='{{project}}' AND type='CALLS'

cases.title: no full table scan for a project+label query
cases.sqlite: EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN SELECT id FROM nodes WHERE project='{{project}}' AND label='Method'

cases.title: no vendor/ or generated/ rows in nodes
cases.sqlite: SELECT count(*) FROM nodes WHERE file_path LIKE 'vendor/%' OR file_path LIKE 'generated/%'

cases.title: projects table has the project
cases.sqlite: SELECT count(*) FROM projects WHERE name='{{project}}'

cases.title: file_hashes covers the tier-1 source files
cases.sqlite: SELECT count(*) FROM file_hashes WHERE project='{{project}}' AND rel_path IN ('app/cli.py','app/models.py','app/money.py','app/service.py','app/util/strings.py','hub/hub.py','dup/alpha.py','dup/beta.py','tests/test_service.py','java/src/main/java/com/example/billing/Money.java','java/src/main/java/com/example/billing/Invoice.java','java/src/main/java/com/example/billing/InvoiceService.java','java/src/test/java/com/example/billing/InvoiceServiceTest.java')

cases.title: file_hashes covers the unicode path
cases.sqlite: SELECT count(*) FROM file_hashes WHERE project='{{project}}' AND rel_path='unicode/ünïcødé.py'

cases.title: every edge endpoint exists (referential integrity)
cases.sqlite: SELECT count(*) FROM edges e WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nodes n WHERE n.id=e.source_id) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nodes n WHERE n.id=e.target_id)

cases.title: every node's properties JSON is valid
cases.sqlite: SELECT count(*) FROM nodes WHERE properties IS NOT NULL AND properties <> '' AND NOT json_valid(properties)

cases.title: integrity_check is ok
cases.sqlite: PRAGMA integrity_check

cases.title: journal mode (record; WAL expected for concurrent readers)
cases.sqlite: PRAGMA journal_mode

cases.title: docstrings are in the FTS body column
cases.sqlite: SELECT count(*) FROM nodes_fts WHERE nodes_fts MATCH 'body:hyphenate'

cases.title: FTS name column finds a symbol
cases.sqlite: SELECT count(*) FROM nodes_fts WHERE nodes_fts MATCH 'name:checkout'

cases.title: store_meta / schema version row exists
cases.sqlite: SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name IN ('store_meta','runtime_settings','config')
